HTTP server implementation for the OVAL/CVE dictionary service, exposing REST endpoints to query vulnerability definitions by package name, CVE ID, and OS family/release via an Echo web framework.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `Start` | func | Initializes and starts the Echo HTTP server with middleware, logging, and route registration |
| `newRequestLoggerConfig` | func | Builds a JSON-formatted request logger config writing to a given `io.Writer` |
| `health` | handler | `GET /health` — liveness check, returns `200 OK` |
| `getByPackName` | handler | `GET /packs/:family/:release/:pack[/:arch]` — returns OVAL defs matching a package name |
| `getByCveID` | handler | `GET /cves/:family/:release/:id[/:arch]` — returns OVAL defs matching a CVE ID |
| `getAdvisories` | handler | `GET /advisories/:family/:release` — returns all advisories for a distro release |
| `countOvalDefs` | handler | `GET /count/:family/:release` — returns total OVAL definition count |
| `getLastModified` | handler | `GET /lastmodified/:family/:release` — returns the last modification timestamp |

## API Routes Summary

```text
GET /health
GET /packs/:family/:release/:pack/:arch
GET /packs/:family/:release/:pack
GET /cves/:family/:release/:id/:arch
GET /cves/:family/:release/:id
GET /advisories/:family/:release
GET /count/:family/:release
GET /lastmodified/:family/:release
```

## Usage Example

```go
import (
    "github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary/db"
    "github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary/server"
)

func main() {
    // driver implements the db.DB interface
    driver, _ := db.NewDB("sqlite3", "/path/to/oval.db", false)

    // Start with access log written to ./logs/access.log
    if err := server.Start(true, "./logs", driver); err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
}
```

Bind address and port are read from Viper config keys `bind` and `port`. Access logs are written as newline-delimited JSON including latency, status, remote IP, and byte counts.
